summary.text: James Nowak is the Republican nominee for Ohio Senate District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Paula Hicks-Hudson.
He is an attorney who has practiced law for more than 40 years.

paragraphs.text: Nowak earned his bachelor's degree and law degree from the University of Toledo and has been active in the Point Place Business Association and Kiwanis International, according to Ballotpedia.

He was the Republican nominee for Ohio House District 45 in 2014 and 2016, losing to incumbent Teresa Fedor both times, and ran for Toledo City Council District 6 in 2018 and in a 2021 special election.
